discussion_comments.comment_body: Addressed in 229051e. Rather than a scrolling strip (which would clip the attached-tab effect), tabs now shrink and truncate their labels, so + and the hide button stay reachable regardless of tab count.

I think this is reading the pre-229051e code: the tab wrapper is min-w-0 (not shrink-0) and the label is min-w-0 truncate, so tabs shrink rather than overflow. Verified in the running app with 10 tabs open: labels truncate with an ellipsis and both + and the hide button remain fully visible and clickable. I kept shrink-to-fit over a scrolling strip because overflow clipping would cut the active tab's join to the panel body.
[P3] The scroll-to-bottom button uses smooth scrolling even with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, ignoring the user’s motion preference.

Fixed in cc231f9d9. MessageScrollerButton now resolves behavior from prefers-reduced-motion (auto when reduced, smooth otherwise), with the explicit behavior prop still winning as an override. Added a test for both cases in sdk/packages/ui/tests/message-scroller.test.tsx.
